Hello,

I’m interested in purchasing your Bitforton BS-4 miner, but before placing
an order, I would like to clarify a few things.

1. Shipping to Hungary / European warehouse

- Do you currently have this miner in stock in your European warehouse?
- Can you ship directly to Hungary from within the EU?
- Will I have to pay any additional customs duties or import taxes?
- Is Hungarian VAT already included in the displayed price?
- What is the estimated shipping cost and delivery time to Hungary?

2. Software and user interface

- Does the miner come with Harlo OS pre-installed?
- Is Harlo OS the standard operating system, or does the miner use
different firmware?
- Can I access the dashboard through a web browser, just like with my
NerdQaxe++?
- Does the interface provide real-time hashrate, power consumption, chip
temperatures, fan speeds and mining statistics?
- Can I adjust frequency, voltage, fan speed and overclocking settings?
- Can I configure my own mining pool, including Solo CKPool?
- Are firmware updates provided regularly?

3. Noise and cooling

- What is the actual noise level in dB during normal operation?
- Is the miner suitable for use in an apartment?
- Are the fans speed-controlled automatically?
- Can the fan speed be adjusted manually?

4. Package contents

- Does the price include everything needed to operate the miner?
- Is the Mean Well power supply included?
- Are all necessary cables, connectors and cooling fans included?
- Do I need to purchase anything separately to get started?

5. Warranty and support

- What is the warranty period?
- Where are warranty claims and repairs handled?
- Do you provide technical support after purchase?

I already own a NerdQaxe++ and a Bitaxe miner, and I am considering
expanding my home mining setup.

I am particularly interested in a reliable, quiet miner with good
performance and low maintenance requirements.

Thank you in advance for answering my questions.

Best regards,

Ferenc

Hello Ferenc,

Thank you for the detailed questions. A NerdQaxe++ and a Bitaxe are a good place to step up from. I've answered everything I can confirm and been clear about anything I can't.

1. Shipping to Hungary

The BS-4 is a pre-sale. Batch 1 is open on a first come, first served basis, and the listing shows
the Mean Well LRS-350 (350W continuous, 12V DC, 100-240V input with a 115/230V region selector switch)
 together with a ship date of November 30, 2026. When I checked this morning, there was only 1 unit left of the 100 in this batch. We can't hold or reserve a unit, so it goes to whoever checks out first. The plug variant is matched to your address, so a Hungarian order gets the EU plug and cord. The shipping cost is calculated at checkout once you enter your address.

I don't want to guess about Hungarian VAT, customs duties, import taxes, delivery time or whether it ships from inside the EU. I've passed those questions to my colleagues. They're back today at 10am ET, and their answer will arrive as a reply to this email.

2. Firmware and interface

The BS-4 comes with Bitfortun's own stock firmware, not Harlo OS. We're not offering Harlo OS on any miner right now. The team is working on an alternative and will share news when it's ready, but there is no date yet.

Solo and pool mining both work, and you pick in the dashboard
, so you can set your own pool, including Solo CKPool. The unit also has
an onboard screen for hashrate, temperature and shares
.

Bitfortun has published the firmware for the smaller BS-1, and it comes from the same NerdQaxe / Bitaxe family your NerdQaxe++ uses. It
provides a web dashboard, stratum mining support, and full control over frequency, voltage, and cooling
. However, Bitfortun has not published the BS-4 firmware source. I can't yet confirm field by field that the BS-4 dashboard shows exactly the same readings, such as wall power and per-chip temperatures, so I won't promise that. I also can't promise how often Bitfortun releases updates.

If you want those details confirmed before you buy, JD, our hardware lead, has the unit on his bench. He and the community are very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , so just mention @nullhashrate.

On overclocking: the unit is rated at 18 TH/s.
Turning it down is easy and a lot of owners run that way overnight, where it uses less power and makes less noise.
 Running it above 18 TH/s is overclocking. That is at your own risk, and it may void the warranty if damage results.

3. Noise and cooling

It is rated at about 50 dB, roughly a desk fan or a quiet dishwasher across a room. You will hear it, and you can talk over it.
 That figure is the manufacturer's rating, not a measurement we took ourselves.

It can work in an apartment. If it shares a bedroom, put it on the far side and run it in a lower mode. It is
water cooled: a closed loop block and radiator carry the heat off 4 BM1373 chips
. Also,
the voltage regulators sit on the back of the board, in the path of the fan
, which helps it last. At about 300 W it gives off a noticeable amount of warmth.

On the fans: in the BS-1 firmware the fan is controlled automatically, and you can also set the speed by hand. I expect the BS-4 to work the same way, but JD on Discord can confirm it.

4. In the box

The box contains the BS-4, a power cord and the Mean Well LRS-350 power supply.
The supply is already fused.
 The cooling is built into the unit and it connects by Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) or Ethernet, so you don't need to buy anything else to start mining. An Ethernet cable is optional.

5. Warranty and support

All products are covered against defects for 3 months from delivery. Within the first 7 days of delivery, defective units may be returned or exchanged directly with us.
 Warranty claims come to us. Our technical team diagnoses the fault first, and the return or replacement is then decided with you. Please keep in mind that opening or modifying the unit, for example swapping the fans, voids the warranty.

You do get technical support after purchase. That means us, by replying in this thread, plus JD and the community on Discord.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
